Definition: neuter of a compound of G1722 and G3571; (adverbially) by night:--before day.
BiblicalUsage: A great while before day, Jesus rose up in Mark 1:35, went out to a solitary place, and prayed — before the crowds, before the demands, before the day began.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the first hours belong to God, and if Jesus needed a solitary place before daybreak, I need one too.
